text: Which UPSC coaching is worth the fee? We compared 10 institutes using only what they publish themselves: fees, test series, how fast answers are evaluated, refund terms. We also looked at what the consumer regulator found about results claims in 2025. No institute paid to be listed. Where a page did not say something, we wrote "not stated". Also inside: three toppers who studied mostly alone, and eight questions to ask before you pay anyone. Read it here: https://upscprepnotes.in/content/best-upsc-coaching-2027?utm_source=telegram&utm_medium=channel&utm_campaign=blog_launch

Cleared Mains 2026? Interview guidance, free vs paid What we found on the institutes' own pages: • Drishti IAS and Legacy IAS say their 2026 programs are free • Vajiram & Ravi lists ₹600 incl. GST for non-students, starting 11 Nov • Vision IAS lists ₹500 • Others did not state a fee The post also covers what a good mock gives you and why three to five mocks, spaced out, beat ten in one week. Read it here: https://upscprepnotes.in/content/upsc-interview-guidance-programs-2026?utm_source=telegram&utm_medium=channel&utm_campaign=blog_launch

Prelims and Mains test series for 2027, side by side Listed Prelims prices on the pages we read run from ₹1,999 (PW CSAT) to ₹15,499 (ForumIAS offline). Mains evaluation time ranges from 3 to 4 days at Insights to 7 working days at Vajiram. We put tests, price, evaluation time and refund terms in one place. Some series say no refund, so check before you pay. Tip: take a sample test first. It tells you more than any brochure. Read it here: https://upscprepnotes.in/content/best-upsc-test-series-2027?utm_source=telegram&utm_medium=channel&utm_campaign=blog_launch

Which optional scores highest? We checked 239 toppers Median optional marks (Paper I + II, out of 500), CSE 2022 to 2025: Mathematics 289 Anthropology 281.5 Geography 279 Sociology 278.5 PSIR 267 Law 259.5 But the highest median did not mean the best ranks, and this is toppers only, so it is not a success rate. Choose on your background, interest and syllabus size.
